qualityWarnings.message: Issuer consolidated revenue before special gaming tax, retaining each published accounting presentation: H1 2011-H1 2016 commission expenses are not silently netted against revenue; H1 2017 onward uses after-commission revenue, including the published restated H1 2017 comparative. Retrospective official correction, not point-in-time history. Revenue and operating-cost categories are reviewed for all stored FY2018-FY2025 and H1 2011-H1 2026 periods. H1 2011-H1 2016 report commissions as a separate expense; H1 2017 is the comparative explicitly restated in the 2018 interim report, not a point-in-time claim. No unpublished IFRS15 bridge or unreported earlier H2 is invented. Core operating income = revenue less gaming tax, raw materials, depreciation, employee benefits, other operating expenses and separately expensed commissions where disclosed; core EBITDA adds depreciation once. This excludes other income, investee results and non-operating derivative fair-value changes and is NOT the issuer's adjusted EBITDA. Other income/cash-flow/balance fields are not certified by this review. Expenses are reported by nature without a gross-profit subtotal; provider cost-of-revenue/gross-profit amounts are archived, not invented as official gross margin.
Provider annual and interim revenues do not reconcile; their reporting bases must not be mixed.
